renderers.proof_asset_boundary: source media and rights ledger stay OpenClaw-controlled; Canva is renderer/polish only

renderers.availability: available_when_local Chrome/Fontsource renderer and Pattern Lab QA pass
renderers.proof_asset_boundary: uses rights-ledgered source media only; no AI proof fabrication
must use OpenClaw rights-ledgered media and approved slot schema
must not choose historical claims or source evidence

hard_rules: Canva is always attempted first when available.
Fallback requires a recorded Canva blocker.
Every production candidate must show renderer provenance.
Every production candidate must pass source-first and thumbnail QA gates.
Owner approval is still required before any YouTube thumbnail replacement.
